macros.name: afzendernaam
macros.doc: Use \afzendernaam{name} to set the name of the sender.

macros.name: bijlagen
macros.doc: To add a list of attachments, \bijlagen{attachments} is to be used.

macros.name: cienaam
macros.doc: \cienaam{committee} sets the committee that was in charge of sending the letter.

macros.name: geenbijlagen
macros.doc: \geenbijlagen means that there are no attachments.

macros.name: geenkleur
macros.doc: To set the boolean aes@optkleur, it is possible to use \welkleur to set it to true or \geenkleur to set it to false.

macros.name: geenopening
macros.doc: If, \geenopening instead, one wants the header without an opening paragraph, \geenopening is to be used.

macros.name: onsk
macros.doc: \onsk{reference} adds the reference of the sender.

macros.name: opening
macros.doc: \opening{text} creates an opening paragraph, together with the letter header.

macros.name: signature
macros.doc: To add a signature to the letter, \signature{signature} should be used.

macros.name: signatures
macros.doc: \signatures takes two arguments and saves both as signatures.

macros.name: uwk
macros.doc: \uwk{reference} adds a reference, used for invoices.

macros.name: welkleur
macros.doc: To set the boolean aes@optkleur, it is possible to use \welkleur to set it to true or \geenkleur to set it to false.

envs.name: brief
envs.doc: To start writing a letter, the environment brief should be used.
